title: Los Angeles motion to study a ban on algorithm-based rent-setting software
requirement: Would instruct the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on the number of owners and managers using algorithm-based software to set rents and on the feasibility of banning that software in the City.
quoted_span: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on the number of ownership and management entities that are using algorithm-based software to establish rents and the feasibility of instituting a ban on the use of this software to set rents in the City.
